status: National V4: thin local research API over ACCEPTED components 13 (V2 province compatibility), 14 (catalog), 19 (geometry), 21/23 (evaluation) and 22 (spatial runtime); no fit, no refit, no network; production_ready is always false

diagnostics_2026.note: national V4: 2026 records are not yet linked to the national network; diagnostics_2026 is optional and reported unavailable

geometry.snapshot: accepted national notebook-19 universe (26,740 qualified DOH 2000 m segments), manifest sha256 720c13fb4bc24d3599951da5ed03a06a4ce0999de84d6b8f98243f7d77d5714b

transport.cors_note: explicit localhost allowlist, no wildcard, no credentials; transport constants are mirrored in backend/api/app.py because they are needed before this file is verified

routes_doc.GET /health: liveness only (200 while the process runs)
routes_doc.GET /ready: 200 research_backend_ready (production_ready false) or 503 with sanitised component codes
routes_doc.GET /api/v1/metadata: versions, limits, components, colour cutoffs, coverage rules
routes_doc.GET /api/v1/evaluation: accepted 21 summary with numeric selected + strong-baseline pooled/period OOF 2022-23 and seen 2024-25 metrics per unit + accepted 23 2026 diagnostic aggregates (separate, limits explicit)
routes_doc.GET /api/v1/provinces: 77 catalog provinces (representative label points, never event locations)
routes_doc.GET /api/v1/history: province retrospective monthly history 2021-01..2025-12 (query: province_key, start_month, end_month[, categories][, top_k])
routes_doc.GET /api/v1/segments: qualified segment GeoJSON by bbox=west,south,east,north with limit/cursor
routes_doc.POST /api/v1/spatial/history: notebook-14 segment history before the SAME target issue/label cutoff + period status
routes_doc.POST /api/v1/predictions: preserved V2 province endpoint via notebook-13 predict_batch {requests[1..128]} (province scope, never rescaled to roads)

scope_statements: Quantities are expected SELECTED+LINKED recorded-count rates per segment (or province) and horizon; not an individual accident probability, not per-vehicle risk, never summed into a route probability; no safest-route claim.

Spatial predictions use the accepted notebook-22 benchmark artifact for target dates 2024-01-01..2027-12-31 only; 2024-25 are previously seen diagnostics and dates after 2025-12-31 are research scenarios without observed ground truth. 2021-23 prospective requests are refused (no fold artifact retained).
Future weather/AADT context is not available live: missing context routes to the core component (reported per row); nothing is imputed as zero.
Historical categories are recorded attributes, not causes and not model explanations; empty history is not safety.
Local research backend only: no authentication, no deployment, no routing engine, no frontend; production_ready is false.
